sprint_name: IVARA Finalization Sprint: From Research Prototype to Research-Ready System
sprint_phases: Phase 1: Starting point verification and manifest
Phase 2: Proper implementation of candidate IVARA-Hybrid architecture with fallback routing and invariants
Phase 3: Decision-grade evaluation runner and preflight gates
Phase 4: Independent versioned human-review artifact (30-40 cases) and verdict import utility
Phase 5: Focused controlled experiment on fresh held-out questions (4 arms)
Phase 6: In-depth quality/error investigation and regression test
Phase 7: Research deliverables and editable architecture diagram
